name: Session Handoff 2026-10-01 (All Clients)
body:
> Handoff · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Agency-wide handoff compiled before archiving old Claude Code sessions. It reviewed 416 sessions (2026-05-18 to 2026-10-01); about 30 were truly agency-wide (tool setup, EOD reporting, trackers, skills/agents, portfolio). 17 older transcripts were already gone and are reconstructed from memory and files only. No secrets are copied; only storage locations are named. Client-specific handoffs live separately: [Pipeliners - Session Handoff 2026-10-01](lib:brain-pipeliners-session-handoff-2026-10-01), [Summit AZ - Session Handoff 2026-10-01](lib:brain-summit-az-session-handoff-2026-10-01).

# Standing decisions
- Client WordPress sites are read-only for Claude: copy-paste fix lists, live edits only with Kim's quoted approval per task.
- Google Ads read-only via MCP; live edits only in the UI with quoted authorization. Scott is hiring a dedicated Ads person (Jul 16); Kim's weekly Ads tasks deleted.
- Keyword research (Search Atlas + Keyword Planner) before drafting any blog. Claims discipline: no invented specs, 24/7, same-day or savings claims. No em dashes.
- Pipeliners blogs: "Pipeliners" never "Pipeliners USA"; no "pipeline/pipelining/pigging"; author Jake Shaker.
- Pages edited in September are frozen until their 4-week check.
- GBP images: internal pipe damage or lining work only.
- From Scott's meetings: Search Atlas diagnoses, Claude fixes; push positions 11 to 20 to page 1; search terms twice a week; 2 press releases per month; $50/month backlinks per client; Pipeliners Ads pause to LSA (Aug 12) reversed Aug 19.
- Tools: per-host SSH keys; six custom subagents at user level; SearchFit skills are generic (client blogs still via seo-blog-writer); visibility tracker refreshed on demand only.

# Tool status (late Sep)
Google Ads working read-only; GoHighLevel working (tokens in `GHL\.env`, rotate every 90 days); **Search Atlas connector failing since Sep 29** (Chrome fallback; rank projects Summit 84536, Pipeliners 34164, Alphalete 82050); Higgsfield working on Scott's credits; Instantly v1 API only; Keystone via Chrome; SSH summit/alphalete/namehero working, **pipeliners unverified**; NameHero disk quota full Jul 31; LibreOffice not installed; gh CLI fine-grained token for one account expires Oct 28 2026.

# Pending (highlights)
- **Security first:** rotate the Instantly API key (pasted in a Jun 24 chat); change the password pasted in a Jun 12 NameHero chat; check that GitHub repo kimai-i/CRM and the Visibility Tracker artifact are not unintentionally public.
- Tooling: fix Search Atlas connector; confirm `ssh pipeliners`; Scott to free NameHero disk; update eod-report-writer path to `_Shared (All Clients)\EOD Reports\`; decide on Jun 17 gap ideas (em-dash hook, root CLAUDE.md, cannibalization tracker, slash commands, tools folder).
- Google Ads: Pipeliners attribution fix, Summit conversion tracking fix, Alphalete zero conversions Sep 4 to 13, close stale "Shift budget to LSA" Keystone item.
- Keystone: 27 of 33 meetings not attributed to a client; 79 open action items as of Aug 20.
- Visibility tracker check dates Oct 2 to Oct 26 (Summit Rank Math review, Pipeliners Buckeye, Batch 1, Alphalete posts).
- Page trackers: move share pins to newest versions; approve 11 Pipeliners blog merges.
- Portfolio: locate moved `kim portfolio` folder, get Scott's OK before naming clients, collect GSC screenshots and testimonials.
- Internal CRM side project and DRAFT website-connection SOP still open.

# Recurring workflows documented
EOD report, start-of-shift status tracker, `/work-report`, GSC indexing run ([GSC Indexing Tracker](lib:brain-gsc-indexing-tracker)), search-terms review ([Search Terms Check Log](lib:brain-search-terms-check-log)), SEO visibility tracker refresh ([SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker)), page-tracker sync, live page edit with approval, Higgsfield images, SSH connection test.
